result.brief: 提出多视角图像驱动的全向主体一致视频生成方法，含自动化数据合成管线与基于表面法向图的几何条件注入，并构建4K数据集与评测基准。
result.reason: Subject-consistent video generation with geometry conditioning from multi-view images; contributes data pipeline and normal-map conditioning for video diffusion, relevant to video generation and 3D-consistent world modeling.
